# Hand-Crafted Template Counts in *Question Generation from a Knowledge Base with Web Exploration*

## Introduction

Question generation from a knowledge base (KB) is the task of generating questions related to the domain of the input KB ([Song & Zhao, 2016](document_1.txt)). The problem is challenging because function words and morphological forms for entities are abstracted away when a KB is created ([Song & Zhao, 2016](document_1.txt)). Previous work has addressed this challenge by relying on massive human-labeled data; for example, one approach trains a neural machine translation (NMT) system with 10,000 triple–question pairs, where the question part is human generated ([Song & Zhao, 2016](document_1.txt)).
